slots.order: k from -heading_steps to +heading_steps (outer), nominal length ascending (inner); slot = 2*(k+6) + length index

candidate_features.name: clearance_term
candidate_features.rule: min(clearance - r_infl, clearance_cap) / clearance_cap; 0 when not collision-valid

polar_profile.order: distance to the first OCCUPIED cell for k = -6..6, then distance to the first non-FREE cell for k = -6..6 (traversed counts as FREE, outside the grid counts as non-FREE); both capped at cap_m and divided by cap_m

selection.tie_order: P4 L3: smaller |k|, then k >= 0, then shorter nominal length
